notes.text: The sheet carries 22 at upper left in the main dark hand and 52 at lower left in another hand’s pale pencil. It begins and ends within continuing prose. The reported 27 writing baselines comprise 23 prose baselines, three levels in the upper/cancelled diagram, and one cancelled interline; foliation is inventoried separately.

The manuscript describes the germ of the image at x as the intersection of the germs B_α corresponding to the written z_α∈A. It discusses morphisms attached to strictly increasing maps of nonempty totally ordered sets with the stated cofinal property, asserts an equivalence with a category of possibly empty totally ordered sets through adjoining a last element ω, and introduces the written Γ assignment. The final sentence begins an assertion about recovering data from Γ(∅) and continues off the page. These are accounts of the author’s claims, not independent proof checks.

The two clear Σ(n) crops show a left-angle superscript. The final Σ(0) exponent is compact and dark and remains *|<. No cross-occurrence normalization is made. The Γ assignment has only a visible dash after d; no mathematical expectation has supplied an arrowhead.

Three cancellations in the upper diagram remain partly unreadable. The lower cancelled x/leftward-arrow/Σ(0) row is retained with doubt. The lower interline provisionally reads qui équivaut à under a long crossing stroke; its attachment and revision order are not established. F occurs between d′ and live un. No verbal mathematical caveat is visible in the live prose.
